# Generate and manually edit reflection prompts

Generate a prompt for an additional entry or saved-entry edit, review it before use, and double-click or use the accessible Edit prompt button to write your own question. Prompt and reflection drafts survive reload; late or received-offline AI output never overwrites manual input. Source-event replay recreates the saved questions without inference. Every action has a full-page zero-pixel comparison with checks beneath the image. Provider responses are fictional.

Viewport: mobile-chromium.
